notes.title: Small Patches / UI QoL Update (v1.05)
notes.content:
[h2]Bugfixes and changes[/h2]
Endgame/Fullgame spoilers ahead!
[list]
[*] You can now toggle the scanline animation that plays during gameplay to be a static image instead of animating.
[*] [spoiler]Outerbound exits[/spoiler] are now shown in the hub regardless if you completed the level or not, and have the "Missing Hightlighter" setting toggled on.
[*] On the [spoiler]extra levels[/spoiler] scene, "[spoiler]Despair[/spoiler]" now shows as completed when you complete it.
[*] While in the [spoiler]ending sequence[/spoiler], you can no longer [spoiler]cycle[/spoiler]. (Unsure what caused this)
[*] I've also moved quite a lot of files around! The game should work [i]sliiightly[/i] faster, but you shouldn't notice any difference.
[/list]

Thank you for all the feedback! I've made a small list of which I'll try to implement some of them into the game.
[h2]The game's next update will...[/h2]
[list]
[*] Completely rework a certain level that doesn't have a hint, as I feel like it doesn't do a great job on what it tries to accomplish.
[*] Hopefully add a simple rebinding system for keyboard/controller.
[/list]

notes.title: Steam Cloud + Bugfixing (v1.04)
notes.content:
[h2]Cloud saving has been added to the game![/h2]
[h3]Please [b]BACK UP[/b] your save-file just in case, you can do so by copying the file located in: [code]%USERPROFILE%/AppData/LocalLow/Half Sun Games/A Directionless Cycle. (Windows)[/code][/h3]
For steam Deck users, it should work fine?
I'm unsure if it'll collide with any PC saves, but make sure to back up in case. Thank you!

Also... Added a backup system! It should (hopefully) back up periodically into a backup folder, found next to the custom levels folder. This was added in case you'd like to revert your save-file, or somehow lost a recent save.

[h2]Bugfixes and changes[/h2]
Endgame spoilers ahead!
[list]
[*] Edited some [spoiler]move trials[/spoiler] to make it less tedious to complete. (Around 1-2 extra buffer moves)
[*] Exiting back to menu while in [spoiler]The Core[/spoiler] now correctly sets [spoiler]stars to "???"[/spoiler].
[*] Added a mastery outline to [spoiler]The Core[/spoiler].
[*] Edited in missing walls in [spoiler]Core: Entry (???)[/spoiler].
[*] Fixed carving interactions ignoring valid inputs while a dead box was near the carving.
[/list]

notes.title: Miscellaneous fixes (v1.0 ~> v1.031)
notes.content:
[h2]Here's a list of all the patches that have been pushed out since release, in chronological order.[/h2]

Spoilers! I can't classify them, so be careful yourself and don't click if you haven't beaten the game:
[list]
[*] [spoiler]W1-???[/spoiler] had a second [spoiler]"Path of light"[/spoiler] (which did nothing).
[*] Achievement [spoiler]"Encoded" now triggers with its specific codes[/spoiler].
[*] Selecting [spoiler]up from W1-5[/spoiler] now selects [spoiler]W1-5.1[/spoiler] instead of [spoiler]W1-5.2[/spoiler] as a default.
[*] Added a settings button to the pause menu:
[*] [list] [*] Ability to tweak SFX values. [/list][*] [list] [*] Ability to tweak BGM values. [/list][*] Added hint text to [spoiler]"W3-7.1"[/spoiler], I'll tweak that level in the future.
[*] Updated settings sound sliders to now say "Music" instead of "M"
[*] Removed a ghost block in [spoiler]ending[/spoiler].
[*] Fixed [spoiler]Shadow Step's[/spoiler] hint level.
[*] [spoiler]W3-10[/spoiler] is now beatable with its [spoiler]purple star.[/spoiler] (Sorry about that!)
[*] Changed [spoiler]Reunion's outside screen[/spoiler], now helps with a different puzzle.
[*] Your game will now default to 1920x1080 upon first booting up.
[*] Fixed an issue where [spoiler]red outlines (inverse indicator)[/spoiler] wouldn't show up, visual bug.
[*] Increased undo cap to 1k moves. (Pretty much infinite)
[/list]

Thanks again for playing! This has been a wild release week thanks to you all.
